speaker: A
word: Would you give an AI agent access to the production environment?
translation: Você daria a um agente de IA acesso ao ambiente de produção?
pronunciation: /wʊd juː ɡɪv æn ˌeɪˈaɪ ˈeɪdʒənt ˈæksɛs tuː ðə prəˈdʌkʃən ɪnˈvaɪrənmənt/
portuguesePhonetic: [uûd iú guív én ÊI-ÁI ÊI-djânt ÉK-sés tú dâ pra-DÂK-shân in-VAI-rân-mânt]

speaker: B
translation: Eu começaria com acesso somente de leitura.

speaker: A
word: What if it needs to change a setting?
translation: E se ele precisar alterar alguma configuração?
pronunciation: /wʌt ɪf ɪt niːdz tuː tʃeɪndʒ ə ˈsɛtɪŋ/
portuguesePhonetic: [uât íf ít nídz tú tchêindj a SÉ-tin]

speaker: B
word: In that case, I’d require approval from someone on the team.
translation: Nesse caso, eu pediria aprovação de alguém da equipe.
pronunciation: /ɪn ðæt keɪs aɪd rɪˈkwaɪər əˈpruːvəl frʌm ˈsʌmwʌn ɑːn ðə tiːm/
portuguesePhonetic: [in dét kêis, áid ri-KUAI-âr a-PRÚ-vâl frâm SÂM-uân ón dâ tím]

speaker: A
word: I agree. I also want a record of everything it does.
translation: Concordo. Também quero um registro de tudo o que ele fizer.
pronunciation: /aɪ əˈɡriː aɪ ˈɔːlsoʊ wɑːnt ə ˈrɛkərd ʌv ˈɛvriθɪŋ ɪt dʌz/
portuguesePhonetic: [ái a-GRÍ. ái ÓL-sôu uónt a RÉ-kârd âv É-vri-fin ít dâz]
